name: turtle-language-server
displayName: Turtle RDF Language Server (TTL, OWL, SHACL)
description: Fast Turtle (.ttl) and RDF 1.2 support written in Rust: syntax highlighting, error checking, completion of 80+ vocabularies (rdf, rdfs, owl, skos, shacl, schema.org, foaf), hover docs, go to definition, rename and quick fixes for ontologies and linked data.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted workspaces turtle.server.path and turtle.imports.network are ignored: the bundled server is used and nothing is fetched over the network.

virtualWorkspaces.description: The language server reads Turtle files from disk.

turtle.server.path.markdownDescription: Path to the `turtle-lsp` binary. Leave empty to use the one bundled with the extension, then `turtle-lsp` on `PATH`. This is a machine setting: a project's own `.vscode/settings.json` cannot change it, so opening a repository never runs a binary it chose.

turtle.prefixes.markdownDescription: Prefixes available in every Turtle file, e.g. `{ "ex": "http://example.org/" }`. A `prefixes.ttl` in the project does the same per folder.

enumDescriptions: Show labels only for terms whose IRI does not say what they are, such as `ex:P1234`.
Show the label of every term that has one.
turtle.inlayHints.labels.markdownDescription: Which terms get their `rdfs:label` (or `skos:prefLabel`) shown as an inlay hint.

turtle.shacl.enabled.markdownDescription: Validate data against the SHACL shapes in the workspace.

turtle.shacl.maxTriples.markdownDescription: Skip SHACL validation when the workspace holds more triples than this.

turtle.shacl.onType.markdownDescription: Also validate about a second after you stop typing, on the unsaved text. When off, validation runs on save only.

turtle.lint.undescribedTerms.markdownDescription: Warn about terms in your own namespaces that are used but described nowhere in the workspace.

turtle.imports.network.markdownDescription: Fetch `owl:imports` that are not in the workspace over the network. Ignored in untrusted workspaces.

turtle.format.lineWidth.markdownDescription: Line width the formatter aims for.

turtle.trace.server.description: Log the communication between VS Code and the server (Output panel → Turtle).

semanticTokenModifiers.description: A term in one of your own namespaces that no file in the workspace describes (often a typo).

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/grammar.test.mjs test/manifest.test.mjs && node test/run.mjs
